name: Chester's Butter Puffcorn (The 100% Hull-Free Popcorn Alternative)
whyItWorks: The holy grail movie snack for Crohn's and Colitis patients! Unlike real popcorn which has razor-sharp hulls, Puffcorn is made from puffed cornmeal extruded into soft cloud-like puffs. It has ZERO seeds, ZERO hulls, and literally dissolves into smooth mush on contact with saliva.
prepOrOrderInstructions: The safest crunchy movie snack for IBD. Safe even for patients with intestinal strictures or stomas.
watchOuts: Contains artificial butter flavor and dairy whey seasoning; safe for mild lactose tolerance.
